mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.shop_id, o.vehicle_id, o.service_item, o.service_price, o.total_amount, o.paid_amount, o.expect_date, o.expect_time_slot, o.order_status, o.cancel_reason, o.finish_time, o.rating, o.comment_content, o.pay_status, o.payment_method, o.create_time, s.shop_name, u.nick_name FROM stad_maintenance_order o LEFT JOIN stad_maintenance_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.shop_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stad_maintenance_shop) AS shopCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stad_maintenance_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS orderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stad_maintenance_order WHERE rating IS NOT NULL) AS reviewCount, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating), 1), 0) FROM stad_maintenance_shop) AS avgRating, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updateTime, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM stad_maintenance_order WHERE pay_status = '1') AS revenue

SELECT CASE order_status WHEN '0' THEN '待确认' WHEN '1' THEN '已确认' WHEN '2' THEN '服务中' WHEN '3' THEN '已完成' WHEN '4' THEN '已取消' ELSE '其他' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS `count`, CASE order_status WHEN '0' THEN '#f59e0b' WHEN '1' THEN '#3b82f6' WHEN '2' THEN '#8b5cf6' WHEN '3' THEN '#059669' WHEN '4' THEN '#94a3b8' ELSE '#6b7280' END AS color FROM stad_maintenance_order GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS `month`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM stad_maintenance_order WHERE YEAR(create_time) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY `month`

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serving, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled FROM stad_maintenance_order
